CREATE TABLE canvas_sections (
    id              TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    canvas_id       TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES canvases(id),
    seq             INTEGER NOT NULL,
    kind            TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload         TEXT NOT NULL,                       -- JSON
    rev             INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    created_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at      TEXT NOT NULL,
    quarantined     INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,          -- i18n v1 R4: 1 = export 拒绝
    quarantine_reason TEXT,                               -- 标 quarantine 时的人话理由
    -- D6 (canvas-empty bug 2026-05-25): hide canvas section for chat-mode turns.
    -- Set after turn finalize when turn sections lack insight_card/recommendations
    -- → chat bubble inline_artifacts 仍能 surface 这些 sections; canvas tab 隐藏.
    -- surface_rationale: human-readable why (audit/admin/debug).
    hidden_for_chat_mode INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    surface_rationale TEXT,
    -- report-agent-authorship α v1 (2026-06-24): collapse-in-place. A prior turn's
    -- report block is marked `superseded` when a LATER report-worthy turn composes
    -- a fresh report (BOWHEAD_CANVAS_LATEST_WINS). DISTINCT from hidden_for_chat_mode
    -- (chat-mode hide): superseded sections are STILL returned by list_sections (NOT
    -- filtered) — the frontend renders them as a collapsed, expandable "previous
    -- report" header IN PLACE (not removed). So hydration stays consistent + the
    -- block is user-recoverable by expanding (no separate unhide route needed).
    -- superseded_by_turn = the later turn whose report superseded this one (audit).
    superseded INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
    superseded_by_turn TEXT,
    -- report-agent-authorship α v1 (2026-06-24): the turn that appended this section,
    -- denormalized from canvas_revisions.by_turn_id so the FE can GROUP sections by
    -- their originating turn (the history-collapse accordion shows one foldable entry
    -- per prior report: "第 N 轮 · <title> · N 段 · time"). NULL on legacy rows.
    turn_id TEXT
, schema_version INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, owner TEXT, surface_target TEXT)

CREATE TABLE team_skill (
  id                 TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  team_id             TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name               TEXT NOT NULL,                   -- skill slug; immutable post-create
  display_name       TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  description        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',         -- advertise/trigger desc (untrusted → sanitized)
  source_path        TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',         -- .data/team_skills/<team_id>/<name>/ (SKILL.md + scripts)
  visibility         TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'team_wide', -- team_wide | creator_only (reserved)
  verdict            TEXT,                             -- dry-run judge: pass|fail|skipped|error|NULL
  verdict_json       TEXT,
  risk_report_json   TEXT,                             -- skill-multiruntime S1 (G5): 上传 risk report
  created_by         TEXT,
  status             TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'enabled',  -- enabled | disabled
  size_bytes         INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  created_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
  updated_at         TEXT NOT NULL,
  -- skill-team-governance P1b — 双槽审批状态机（tech-design §1）。approval 只描述「已批槽」
  -- （首提生命周期）；提交更新完全走 candidate_* 候选槽、approval 保持 approved 不动——
  -- 否则更新在审会把 live 团队版从 only_approved 面藏掉（审批期间团队继续用旧已批版）。
  approval           TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'approved', -- pending | approved | rejected（默认 approved 兼容 creator_only 缺省路）
  approved_sha256    TEXT,                             -- 已批内容 hash（落后/已同步判定）
  approved_by        TEXT,
  approved_at        TEXT,
  rejected_reason    TEXT,                             -- 首提拒（L1）；候选拒走 candidate_rejected_reason
  rejected_at        TEXT,
  candidate_path     TEXT,                             -- 候选 bundle 目录（<name>__candidate/）；NULL=无候选
  candidate_submitted_at TEXT,                         -- CAS 键之一（approve/reject 带回比对）
  candidate_sha256   TEXT,                             -- CAS 键之二 + 落后判定
  candidate_state    TEXT,                             -- pending | rejected（仅候选腿）
  candidate_rejected_reason TEXT,
  submitted_by       TEXT                              -- 最近一次提交人
, import_provenance_json TEXT)

CREATE TABLE workspaces (
    id                       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    team_id                   TEXT NOT NULL,
    name                     TEXT NOT NULL,
    datarc_workspace_id      TEXT,
    description              TEXT,
    status                   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active', 'archived')),
    created_at               TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at               TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_synced_at           TEXT, name_key TEXT, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES "teams"(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE workspaces (
    id                       TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    team_id                   TEXT NOT NULL,
    name                     TEXT NOT NULL,
    datarc_workspace_id      TEXT,            -- default datarc PROJECT for this workspace (connector mapping; seeds active_datarc_project). NOT the workspace identity — that is `id` (a ws_*). ws-datarc-decouple S3.
    description              TEXT,
    status                   TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active' CHECK(status IN ('active', 'archived')),
    created_at               TEXT NOT NULL,
    updated_at               TEXT NOT NULL,
    last_synced_at           TEXT, name_key TEXT, revision INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
    FOREIGN KEY (team_id) REFERENCES teams(id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)
